author: Unknown; Jewish tradition names Samuel
overview: After Joshua, Israel falls into a repeating cycle: the people turn away from God, are oppressed by enemies, cry out, and God raises up a leader (a "judge") to rescue them. The judges include Deborah, Gideon and Samson. Things get steadily worse, and the book ends in chaos: "everyone did what was right in his own eyes."
themes: The cycle of sin and rescue
storyPlace: The unsettled period between entering the land and having kings.
